claims.content: The Auctioneer configures global auction rules including reserve tiers, bid increments, overtime bidding settings, shipping charges, preview periods, and post-close removal times via the Manage Global Settings page.

goal.raw_text: The Auctioneer configures global auction rules including reserve tiers, bid increments, overtime bidding settings, shipping charges, preview periods, and post-close removal times via the Manage Global Settings page.

claims.content: Auctioneer
The Auctioneer navigates to the Manage Global Settings page.

trigger.raw_text: The Auctioneer navigates to the Manage Global Settings page.

claims.content: The Auctioneer configures the Reserve Tier and Bid Increment Sitewide Default Settings by defining user-definable cost tiers, setting corresponding reserve (opening bid) amounts or percentages of cost, and entering discrete bid increment values for each tier.
The Auctioneer clicks the 'Apply Changes' button to save the Reserve Tier and Bid Increment settings.
The Auctioneer configures the Overtime Bidding settings by selecting the On or Off radio button option.
If Overtime Bidding is enabled, the Auctioneer enters the duration of the time extension (between 10 seconds and 60 minutes) in the provided data fields.
The Auctioneer clicks the 'Apply Changes' button to save the Overtime Bidding settings.
The Auctioneer configures the Shipping Settings by entering values for the 'Sitewide 1st Item Shipping Charge' and 'Sitewide Subsequent Items Shipping Charge'.
The Auctioneer optionally configures 'Preferred Customer' shipping charges by setting the 'Revenue Threshold to Qualify for Preferred Status' and the 'New Per-Item Shipping Charge'.
The Auctioneer may configure a Shipping Promotion by specifying the Start Date/Time, End Date/Time, and Promotional Shipping Charge.
The Auctioneer clicks the 'Apply Changes' button to save the Shipping Settings.
The Auctioneer configures the Preview Period by entering the number of hours and minutes new auction items should appear online before the system begins accepting bids.
The Auctioneer configures Post-Close Removals by entering the number of hours and minutes closed auctions should remain available in browse results.
The Auctioneer clicks the 'Apply Changes' button to save the Preview Period and Post-Close Removal settings.
The Auctioneer may choose to override the global Reserve Tier and Bid Increment settings by configuring specific Event Profiles instead of applying changes globally.
If the Auctioneer enters a percentage of cost value under 100% for the opening bid, the system displays the value in bold red to indicate a potential anomaly or special condition.
The Reserve Tier and Bid Increment Sitewide Default Settings are saved and applied to all auction items unless overridden by specific Event Profiles.
The Overtime Bidding setting (On/Off) and time extension duration (if enabled) are saved and active for auctions.
The Shipping Settings including sitewide first item charge, subsequent items charge, Preferred Customer thresholds, and any active Shipping Promotion are saved and applied.
The Preview Period duration (hours and minutes) is saved, determining how long new items appear before bids are accepted.
The Post-Close Removals duration (hours and minutes) is saved, determining how long closed auctions remain visible in browse results.
